stories.title: Riemann hypothesis
stories.summary: Anthropic employee and mathematician Levent Alpöge releases a claimed proof of the Riemann hypothesis. The proof was created with assistance from Claude.
stories.about: In mathematics, the Riemann hypothesis is the statement that the Riemann zeta function has its zeros only at the negative even integers and at complex numbers with real part. Historically, it has had the status of being one of the most important unsolved problems in pure mathematics. It is of great interest in number theory because it implies results about the distribution of prime numbers. It is named after Bernhard Riemann, who proposed it in 1859.
